insights.title: Composition Beats Model Selection
insights.finding: Sailor pipeline found 379 vulns vs Claude Code alone finding 12 (30x)
insights.why: The agent's architecture (how components compose) matters more than which LLM it uses
insights.how: Design multi-phase pipelines (static analysis → LLM synthesis → symbolic execution → validation), not single-pass LLM calls

insights.title: Every Component Is Essential
insights.finding: Removing ANY guidance mechanism collapses performance to near-baseline
insights.why: Don't build a "good enough" agent with missing pieces — each component (targeting, feedback, validation) is load-bearing
insights.how: Include ALL of: static analysis targeting, iterative LLM feedback loops, concrete validation, evidence capture

insights.title: Multi-Agent, Multi-Model
insights.finding: Different LLMs for planning (GPT-o3-mini) vs execution (LLaMA 3.1) vs summarization (GPT-4o) increases accuracy
insights.why: One model for all tasks is suboptimal
insights.how: Route tasks to specialized agents/models based on task type

insights.title: Scope Enforcement at OS Level
insights.finding: Deterministic hooks outside the agent loop prevent scope violations
insights.why: Autonomous agents need hard boundaries, not prompt-instruction boundaries
insights.how: Implement `scope_check.py`-style hooks that run OUTSIDE the agent loop, CIDR-aware

insights.title: Evidence-First
insights.finding: No theoretical findings — only verified PoCs with captured evidence
insights.why: Bug bounty platforms reject reports without working proofs
insights.how: Every finding must produce: working PoC + HTTP evidence + screenshot + CVSS

insights.title: Disclosed-Report Patterns
insights.finding: 681 disclosed-report patterns + 2887 HackerOne cases available as structured data
insights.why: Agent should learn from what actually gets paid, not just theory
insights.how: Train/fine-tune on disclosed reports; use as few-shot examples for vulnerability classes

insights.title: MITRE ATT&CK Mapping
insights.finding: Every technique mapped to ATT&CK, CSF 2.0, ATLAS, D3FEND, AI RMF
insights.why: Structured threat intelligence enables systematic coverage
insights.how: Map every agent action to ATT&CK technique for coverage tracking

insights.title: Lifecycle Security
insights.finding: Protection across initialization → input → memory → decision → execution
insights.why: Agent security failures propagate across stages
insights.how: Defense-in-depth at each agent lifecycle stage
